decisions.reason: The two-component resin injection unit builds directly on the firm's core pumping and dosing know-how, so the firm can read early market feedback and refine the unit with the knowledge it already holds.

This second resin injection variant shares its technology base with Product A, which allows the firm to absorb what it learns across both units, though some risk of consolidating overlapping variants remains.
Automatic airless spray guns are central to the firm's coating-equipment expertise and fit its existing customer base, giving it strong capacity to interpret results and improve the product.
A manual airless spray gun is a core, closely related product where the firm's accumulated knowledge makes refinement straightforward and its commercial value easy to recognise.
Air-assisted airless technology extends the firm's established airless competence in a related direction, so it can assimilate the new knowledge and apply it commercially.

A data logger moves into digital electronics, which lies further from the firm's mechanical knowledge base, but it complements the coating equipment and can be developed further through cooperation, so it is kept despite a higher risk of being dropped.
